titles.title: My Snake-Like Bias Is Obsessed With Me

description:
"Noona, you're my fan, aren't you? There's no way you wouldn't like my dick."

All Boyun did was put on some perfume to win the affection of Hyun Sahoon, her favorite idol. But somehow, she ended up becoming the object of his obsession!

To make matters worse, Sahoon even lied about being a hamster beastkin. His true identity remained a complete mystery.

One thing was certain: her snake-like favorite was definitely lying to Boyun.
